enemies.name: Wisp

telegraph.cue: Flickers brighter before it brushes you

enemies.freed: A tiny light mote with eyes
enemies.lore: Scraps of stolen wind that drift together in flocks. Alone they are only shy.

enemies.name: Thornbat

telegraph.cue: Folds its wings with a screech

enemies.freed: A little bat holding a flower
enemies.lore: Hangs under cliffs and drops on whatever flies past. Purified, it only wants to share its flower.

enemies.name: Stone Sentinel

telegraph.cue: A rune ring charges around it

enemies.lore: An old island guardian the Murk has taught to be afraid. It fires slow orbs at everything.

enemies.name: Murk Eel
enemies.lore: Patrols the same loop under bridges and arches, sweeping a cone of cold light.

enemies.name: Storm Hawk

telegraph.cue: A screech and a flare of its wings

enemies.lore: Matches your speed, whatever it is. Fly well and it will tire before you do.
